Chapter 16: Ah, Where's My Victory BGM? Bring It Over!

Hearing the English teacher say there were three people who scored above 130, Jiang Nian's ears immediately perked up like antennae. After the English exam, he had checked answers with Xu Qianqian.

If not a surefire thing, it was at least foolproof. Since there were three people with scores over 130, then as the saying goes, when three walk together, one is bound to be me.

Even so, his heart was still pounding with anxiety.

"The one who usually gets 130, Zhou Yuan, 101." The English teacher's tone was unkind. "How did you manage this 'single's day' score? Started dating recently?"

The students below burst into laughter. A tall, skinny boy scratched his head and ambled up to the stage to get his test paper. The classroom was instantly filled with a joyous atmosphere.

Someone at the table behind him was already whispering that Zhou Yuting must have gotten over 130. Her total score this time was over 500, so she was probably first in their class.

Hearing this, Jiang Nian just wanted to laugh. Zhou Yuting, first?

Even with a perfect score in English, she would only have 550. Meanwhile, he only needed a 120 in English to easily break 550.

Her being first was purely a case of the money counter being broken—she had no idea of her own worth.

However, opportunities to show off like this were rare in school. Jiang Nian, of course, wouldn't chuckle like some villain, but rather sat in his seat, quietly waiting for his BGM.

Ah, where's my victory BGM? Bring it over!

If a manga-style picture were taken at this moment, Jiang Nian's eyes would be cast in shadow, the corners of his mouth turned up in a slight arc.

Complete with a small speech bubble: "Heh."

"Chen Niannian, 131."

A commotion stirred in the class. The first person with a score over 130 had been announced. The names were read one by one, and a girl's name was called.

"Zhao Fangfei, 137."

Another stir went through the class. Zhao Fangfei was usually inconspicuous, with almost no presence in the class. After a summer break, it seemed everyone was showing their true colors.

In the classroom, a girl turned to look at Zhou Yuting.

"Academic Committee Member, what did you estimate your score to be? Over 130?"

In their eyes, since there were three people with English scores over 130, and two girls' scores had already been announced, the last one had to be Zhou Yuting.

"I'm not sure, probably around 135," Zhou Yuting said, feigning embarrassment, though she was already blooming with joy inside. With a total of 530, she could get promoted out of this class.

Huh, it feels a bit like switching sects in a xuanhuan novel.

"Hiss... 135, that high?" The girl sucked in a breath of cold air. "Doesn't that mean your total score will be over 530? That's good enough for a top-tier university."

"What are you saying? It's just a placement test, not the actual college entrance exam." Zhou Yuting felt a sweet warmth in her heart, but she didn't make any absolute claims. "It might not be over 130, estimations aren't always accurate."

Her words became a self-fulfilling prophecy. On the stage, the English teacher happened to read out Zhou Yuting's name.

"Zhou Yuting, 127."

As the words fell, Zhou Yuting's expression stiffened slightly, but she stood up anyway. At first, she felt awkward, having just said she estimated 135.

But on second thought, 127 wasn't that hard to accept. Her total score was still close to 530.

She could ask Liu Feipeng later to find out the cutoff score for the Olympiad class. Maybe the scores for the entire grade weren't high, and her score would be just enough to get in.

When she returned to her seat, she was still greeted with a wave of admiration. Things like, "As expected of the Academic Committee Member," "Your estimate was only off by a few points," "It's okay, even a bit short is still amazing."

"By the way, if the Academic Committee Member only got 127, who's the last person with a score over 130?"

Zhou Yuting was also taken aback. "Maybe it's Sun Xue."

Someone said, "Her score was already announced, 113. There are only a few people in our class who are good at English, and they all have their papers already."

Zhou Yuting couldn't help but frown. This meant there was another "dark horse in English" in the class. If it was just a student who excelled in one subject, it wouldn't matter much.

But she was afraid...

"Does anyone know what Wang Jie scored?" she asked in a low voice.

"62, I think. His name was called at the beginning."

Hearing this, Zhou Yuting's anxious heart settled down again. Wang Jie's total score was 499, a huge gap from hers. Her total was 527. Barring any surprises, she was first in the class.

Right, there was still Jiang Nian.

"Hey, has Jiang Nian's score been announced?" The nearby students had no idea why Zhou Yuting would suddenly ask about Jiang Nian, as no one had been paying close attention.

"Probably. Didn't notice. Sixty or seventy something, maybe."

Zhou Yuting felt a bit more at ease and began to weave her dream of moving up to the advanced class again. Once in the Olympiad class, she had to create a new persona, one that didn't interact with too many boys.

But she couldn't cut them off completely. She'd keep one or two around to highlight her own charm.

Should she try a new hairstyle? She hadn't tried innocent-looking bangs yet. From now on, she'd dress more purely, find a good-looking top student to tutor her, and build good relationships...

Just as Zhou Yuting was lost in her fantasies, the English teacher on the stage suddenly paused.

"The highest English score in our class this time is 141. An excellent result."

As her words landed, the originally boisterous classroom erupted with exclamations of "Oh!!", "Holy crap, who is it?", and other similar phrases. Everyone who was supposed to be called had been, right?

"Quiet!" the English teacher said.

"Teacher, do we have someone named An Jing in our class?"

The English teacher: "...I'm telling you all to be quiet. Jiang Nian, come up and get your paper."

Normally, few students were afraid of the English teacher. Even when she said to be quiet, not many would pay attention. But when she said the name "Jiang Nian,"...

The classroom instantly fell silent. As if they had seen a ghost, they all turned their heads in unison to look at Jiang Nian's seat.

Zhou Yuting froze, her pupils shrinking as her heart began to race.

Jiang Nian?

Why is it Jiang Nian!

Damn it, his total score for the five subjects was 432! How could his English be 141? Doesn't that add up to... 573?

Is this a joke? How could someone in a parallel class score 573?

Are you damn well fighting above your weight class?!

The class was silent for two or three seconds, then burst into enthusiastic cheers. If Jiang Nian had excelled in just one subject, some might have suspected him of cheating. But if his total score exceeded 570...

Then all doubts were a joke. A student from a parallel class scoring 570 was like pulling a legendary gold card.

"Holy crap! Holy crap! Jiang Nian got 140-something!!"

"For real? That's incredible!"

"Seriously, man? You guys were actually studying during the summer break? Am I the only one who was messing around?!"

"Me too."

"Me too, I was also messing around."

"People with 480, get lost! One more flex and I'll chop you up and feed you to the dogs!"

Jiang Nian had already stood up the moment the English teacher called his name, trying his best not to laugh out loud, his face a mask of breezy indifference.

To be honest, a 140-something in English had also exceeded his expectations. His luck wasn't bad.

"Excellent score. You must have put in a lot of effort at home during the summer break, didn't you?" The English teacher smiled at Jiang Nian, a rare sight. "Do you have any experience you can share with everyone?"

"Uh..." What experience could Jiang Nian have? "Just memorize the 3500 words for the college entrance exam."

Hearing this, the English teacher's smile widened, and she said loudly.

"See? What do I always say? I tell you all to memorize vocabulary, memorize vocabulary! But you don't listen, you always prefer to fumble around on your own, doing math homework in English class. You think I don't see you?"

"If you were all as obedient as Jiang Nian, how much trouble would I be spared!"

Jiang Nian was starting to feel awkward, once again wearing the expression of the sweating yellow emoji bean. The person the English teacher was referring to, the one who did math in her class, was him.
